items.source_excerpt: CAPE CANAVERAL, Florida: A pair of spacecraft slipped into orbit around Mercury on Saturday after an eight-year cruise through the inner solar system to unravel our littlest planet’s mountain of mysteries. The linked robotic explorers — one European, the other Japanese — will separate from one another next month in order to map and study the scorching little planet from different altitudes. The $2 billion (1.7 billion euros) mission is known collectively as BepiColombo. The European Space Agency

items.title: Libya loses $30.8 million as armed group blocks oil pipeline for over 20 days
items.source_excerpt: Libya has suffered a loss of $30.8 million in oil revenue after an armed group blocked the Hamada oil pipeline for more than 20 days, halting the transport of over 302,000 barrels of crude oil. Meanwhile, foreign investors reduced their holdings in 197 other companies by selling 53.3 million shares worth approximately SR929 million. Their ownership remained unchanged in 71 other companies.
